request: Inside a handler, Request.Pattern holds the full route pattern that matched, composed across every mounted or nested sub-router (for a handler on /hi inside Route("/accounts/{accountID}") it is /accounts/{accountID}/hi), not only the part registered on the innermost router.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: set Request.Pattern from RoutePattern() (#1097)
